subject: Syndication fee structure and intro protection — proposal
messages:
From: Rachel Li <rachel@syndicate.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Syndication fee & intro protection — proposal

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Syndicate is excited about the idea of syndicating Redwood's hosted inference offering through our marketplace and OEM partner channels. We put together an initial set of commercial guardrails for a trial syndication arrangement — attached (syndication_terms_v1.pdf). High level: 

- Transaction fee: 10% of net usage revenue for traffic originated via Syndicate (we can scale to 12.5% after $500k ARR).
- Intro crediting: Syndicate-provided leads qualify for a 90-day intro protection window; registration required in our Partner Portal within 5 business days of first demo/contact.
- Co-branded pilot: 90 days, up to 5k free usage credits for qualifying customers.
- Safeguard: If a lead converts via direct Redwood direct-sell within the protection window, Syndicate retains the intro credit unless Redwood can show the lead was independently nurtured.

A few asks from our side: can Redwood commit to a 5-business-day registration SLA, and will you accept a transaction fee that includes downstream reseller commissions (i.e., Syndicate pays the incremental referral to our channel)? We attached a short markup to illustrate.

Would love to set a 30-min call next week to lock the pilot terms.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Li
Head of Partnerships, Syndicate.io
attachment: syndication_terms_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Li <rachel@syndicate.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndication fee & intro protection — proposal

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear proposal and the doc. Quick notes inline and a couple questions before we escalate to commercial: 

On Tue, Jul 18, 2028 at 3:02 PM Rachel Li <rachel@syndicate.io> wrote:
> - Transaction fee: 10% of net usage revenue for traffic originated via Syndicate

We can accept a transaction-based fee but need to align on how "originated" is defined in the routing context. For example, will Syndicate insert an intro token in the signup flow or will attribution be handled via a referral parameter in the API key provisioning?

Regarding the 5-business-day registration SLA: operationally that's tight for our CS/RevOps handoff — Camila, can you weigh in on feasibility?

On the pilot credits: we can carve out a 3-month pilot with 5k credits; we prefer to cap pilot-support to avoid abuse (e.g., single-customer synthetic traffic).

Two items we'd like to propose as alternatives: 
- A 9-month intro protection window for named accounts (larger deals), 90-day for cold intros.
- A tiered transaction fee: 8% first $250k, 10% next band, 12% above $500k (we like graduated incentives).

Happy to hop on a call. Camila & Ben — adding you for ops and commercial input.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Li <rachel@syndicate.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndication fee & intro protection — proposal

Hi all — I reviewed the attached terms and sketched a practical rev-routing matrix that maps attribution sources and registration flows to payout triggers (attached: rev_routing_matrix.xlsx). Key operational proposals from RevOps: 

- Registration window: keep the 5-business-day registration requirement but require a minimum of two data points (email + source token) for auto-approval; manual review within 7 business days for edge cases.
- Attribution token: Syndicate should pass a partner_ref query param on signup and include the same token in the initial API call — this can be validated server-side.
- Crediting window: Graduated protection as Marcus suggested — 90 days for non-named, 270 days for named accounts (> $50k ARR).
- Payout cadence: monthly, with a 30-day net settlement after invoice.

Operational caveats: we need a logging trace (request_id) included in the attribution payload for reconciliation. We'll also limit auto-crediting to the first 3 signups per Partner lead to reduce double-credit risk.

Attached: rev_routing_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains the mapping and sample reconciliation query. If that looks good, we can draft an SOW for the pilot and a short addendum to the partner T&C focusing on attribution and audit access.

Camila
Senior RevOps Manager — Redwood Inference
attachment: rev_routing_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@syndicate.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Li <rachel@syndicate.io>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndication fee & intro protection — proposal

Thanks Camila — this is really helpful and gets us closer. A couple quick replies: 

- We can pass a partner_ref query param and will include a verification webhook to deliver the form data and request_id at signup.
- We prefer a flat 10% during the initial 6-month pilot to simplify accounting, then move to the tiered model after pilot review.
- Syndicate is comfortable with a 90-day standard protection window; we will manually flag "named" accounts during the demo qualification to opt into the 270-day protection.

Next steps from our side: we'll accept your operational terms for token + request_id logging and will send back a redline to the syndication_terms_v1.pdf with the flat pilot fee inserted. Can you confirm Redwood is OK with monthly settlements and a 30-day net after invoice? Also confirm the registration UI will include partner_ref and the 5-business-day register SLA.

Best,
Tom
Head of Channel Ops — Syndicate.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndication fee & intro protection — proposal (internal)

Quick internal summary and proposed go/no-go checklist before we send the SOW: 

1) Attribution spec: partner_ref + request_id webhook — engineering effort estimated 2 sprints (Camila to prioritize).
2) Financials: agree to 10% flat for 6-month pilot; move to tiered bands post-pilot. Finance ok with monthly payout, 30-day net settlement (Ben to raise PO/invoice workflow).
3) Registration SLA: auto-approve on two data points; manual review SLA 7 business days — RevOps to operationalize.
4) Protection window: 90-day default, 270-day for named accounts — legal to capture in addendum.
5) Audit/reconciliation: Syndicate must provide request_id logs for sample audits; Redwood will retain reconciliation rights for 12 months.

Action items: Camila will open a Jira for engineering work and attach the rev_routing_matrix. Marcus will draft a short pilot SOW and circulation plan. I'll prepare the finance playbook and initial invoice template.

If everyone agrees, Marcus — please schedule a 30-min pilot kickoff with Syndicate for next week.

Ben
Revenue Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
